name: CardSpoke Sample Plugins
description: Curated sample plugins maintained in the CardSpoke repository. One entry per package under themes/, features/ and apps/.

plugins.name: Forest
plugins.description: An earthy green theme inspired by woodland canopies. Overrides the core CSS variables so it composes with light/dark mode.

plugins.name: Cyberpunk
plugins.description: Neon-on-black theme. Dark in both light and dark modes, with magenta/cyan accents.

plugins.name: Monochrome
plugins.description: Stark black-and-white brutalist theme with hard shadows and zero border radius.

plugins.name: Auto-Save Indicator
plugins.description: Flashes a 'Saved' badge in the header whenever the store is persisted. Demonstrates ctx.api.middleware ('card.save') and ctx.api.ui.inject.

plugins.name: Card Color Tags
plugins.description: Gives every tag a stable color derived from its text. Demonstrates the 'card.render' middleware hook.

plugins.name: Card Reading Time
plugins.description: Adds an estimated reading time to card tiles with longer bodies. Demonstrates reading card data from the 'card.render' middleware hook.

plugins.name: Kanban Board
plugins.description: Adds a Board button to the header that opens a todo/doing/done kanban view of all cards, driven by tags. Demonstrates an app-layer transformation with ctx.api.data.

plugins.name: Daily Journal
plugins.description: Turns CardSpoke into a journaling app: renames the app and adds a Today's Entry button that creates one dated, tagged journal card per day. Demonstrates overrides.appName and ctx.api.data.createCard.

plugins.name: Pomodoro Desk
plugins.description: Adds a pomodoro timer to the header and counts completed sessions in plugin storage. Demonstrates ctx.api.storage, manifest.config (see the plugin settings panel), and teardownJs cleanup of timers.
